name: Clock Room
description: Every key is a clock with a gong, and the clocks on one wall learn each other's time: they strike apart, fall into step, answer in halves or share the swing out between them.

params.name: Escapement
params.description: What the clock does in a swing: light uneven knocks, one rod then the other, one braked blow, the key's strike with one answer, or a soft hand and a rub that swells.

params.name: Beat
params.description: How many times a second each pendulum swings. Slow leaves long rings between the clock's own strikes; fast turns them into a roll.

params.name: Strikes
params.description: How hard a clock goes on striking, or answers, by itself while its key is down, next to the strike of the key. At zero only the key strikes.

params.name: Wall
params.description: What held clocks learn: to strike together over a low hum, to answer from two sides, to share the swing out thin and bright, or to pass it up from low to high.

params.name: Learn
params.description: How strongly the wall joins the clocks. At zero each keeps its own time for good; high, a new one falls in with the others within a swing.

params.name: Unlike
params.description: How far apart the clocks' own rates are, and a little their force, their hammers and their ring. With Learn low they drift through each other; high, they strain.

params.name: Gong
params.description: The metal that is struck: a deep wire coil, a clear rod, a warbling cup, a high ringing tube, or coils within coils whose wash comes late.

params.name: True
params.description: How well the main tones of the gong are tuned. High they lie on pure intervals over the note; low they bend to where raw metal has them, and some stand out.

params.name: Hammer
params.description: From soft felt, which is slow and wakes the low tones, to bare brass, which is quick and wakes them all. A rub grows brighter with it.

params.name: Bloom
params.description: How much of the upper tones comes late, rising out of the ring after the strike. Under a rub the tones flare one after another.

params.name: Second rod
params.description: How loud the second, brighter rod of every clock is against the first. At one pitch the two beat slowly, and in the swing they answer each other.

params.name: Interval
params.description: How far above or below its note the second rod is tuned. A ringing rod glides there.

params.name: Glow
params.description: A fine rub that keeps the gong sounding between strikes while the key is down, each tone coming and going by itself. More of it is brighter.

params.name: Swing
params.description: How much the pendulum is heard as it passes before the gong, in level, colour and place. High, every clock breathes in its own time.

params.name: Tick
params.description: How loud the clockwork is: small ticks tuned to the note, as the escapement lets its wheel go.

params.name: Case
params.description: What the clocks stand in: warm dull oak, hard dry marble, iron that clangs along, or a glass dome that lets only the high part out and keeps it ringing.

params.name: Run down
params.description: How soon the spring of a held clock is spent. It slows and softens and stops; striking the key winds it again. At zero it goes on for good.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long a gong in the middle of the keyboard rings. Low ones ring longer and high ones shorter.

params.name: Hush
params.description: How quickly a gong is stilled when its key is let go. At zero it rings out; at the top a hand stops it.

params.name: Width
params.description: How wide the clocks stand across the wall, and the two rods of each with them. At zero all sound from the middle.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Each mode is a rotating complex one-pole, four to a lane. The pendulums are phase oscillators coupled through the mean of their sines. The modes of the gongs are voiced by measurement, with the places of a clamped spiral, a rod, a cup and a tube as the starting point.
